customer_concentration.note: FY2025 10-K: no individual customer >=10% of revenue (2023-2025) or of receivables; no top-N figure disclosed

notes: Revenue = continuing operations (advertising) only. The Apps business was sold to Tripledot on 2025-06-30 and is a discontinued operation; Q3'22-Q1'24 use the Software Platform segment revenue, which is the same perimeter (the Q4'24 and Q1'25 advertising revenue in the 2025 releases, 999.5 and 1,159.0, equal the restated continuing-ops revenue in XBRL). Q3'22-Q3'23 come from the Q3'23 8-K segment table, Q4'23 (576.5) and Q1'24 (678.4) are the prior-year comparatives in the Q4'24/Q1'25 8-Ks, and Q2'24 onward come from XBRL. Gross margin is GAAP (no non-GAAP GM reported). No adjusted operating margin is reported (adjusted EBITDA margin 84% in Q2'26), so the field is null and the scorer uses GAAP 77.7%. TTM (Q3'25-Q2'26): OCF 4,527.6, PP&E capex 2.1 (finance-lease principal another 17.2), FCF (OCF-PP&E) 4,525.5 on revenue 6,829.1. Q2'26 OCF was depressed by $640M of H1 cash taxes. Net cash = cash 3,053.3 - long-term debt carrying value 3,515.1 at 6/30/26; no investments; operating leases excluded. Revenue model: ad network / marketing platform paid per install or per action, so transactional. APP reports no non-GAAP EPS, so ttm_pe and eps_growth use GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations (SBC is small, about 4% of revenue): TTM 2.45+3.24+3.56+3.76=13.01 vs prior TTM 1.24+1.72+2.10+2.26=7.32. Q2'26 revenue (1,924) came in just under APP's own guidance midpoint (1,930). No red flag assigned, but note: a 2025 securities class action is still pending (motion to dismiss fully briefed Feb 2026, per the Q2'26 10-Q), and press reports a new securities class action filed in mid-September 2026 after the Q2 miss. Shares are down ~55-60% in 2026. Price $268.22 at the 2026-10-02 close.
